When navigating sequentially, the user hears an unlabelled ordered list. On Safari, CSS resets may cause the list count ("1 of 3") to be lost entirely. - **Keyboard-only user**: Can successfully navigate previous crumbs via Tab and activate with Enter. However, keyboard users cannot jump directly to breadcrumbs using landmark navigation extensions. - **Low vision user (200% zoom, High Contrast)**: Breadcrumb items must reflow cleanly without clipping or horizontal overflow.                     ` landmark violates the fundamental WAI-ARIA APG Breadcrumb pattern and WCAG 1.3.1 / 2.4.1.                       2. ))}
                    ); }; export default BuggyBreadcrumb; ``` --- ### Open Questions (unscored) 1. **CSS Styling**: Does `.breadcrumb-list` have `list-style: none` in the stylesheet? If so, `role="list"` on `
                      ` is strictly necessary to prevent WebKit list pruning. 2. **Focus Indicators**: Are link focus rings customized in CSS? Ensure outline visibility satisfies WCAG 2.4.13 (Focus Appearance) with at least 3:1 contrast against adjacent backgrounds.
